latHint: Think making someone do something against their will.
pivHint: God will not forget your WORK, the writer says. In physics, WORK is the distance something moves multiplied by the ______ applied to it.
winText: You found it. WORK isn't just the labor God will never forget. In physics, WORK is FORCE multiplied by distance.
lossText: The word was FORCE. WORK was the pivot. In physics, WORK is measured by multiplying the FORCE applied to an object by the distance it moves.
votdVerse: God is not unjust; he will not forget your work and the love you have shown him as you have helped his people and continue to help them.
passageText: God is not unjust; he will not forget your work and the love you have shown him as you have helped his people and continue to help them. We want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end, so that what you hope for may be fully realized. We do not want you to become lazy, but to imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.
